summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K solely to announce a monthly dividend of $0.225 per share, payable July 29, 2026, to holders of record June 30, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or reinvestment. No merger, acquisition, tender, spinoff, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine distribution declaration with no structural change, conflict, or extraordinary governance event.
